description: This file defines a Vue.js multiselect component with mixins for functionality and pointer handling, including methods for selection, filtering, and UI interactions.

classes.name: vue-multiselect
classes.description: A Vue.js component for multi-select dropdowns with filtering, tagging, and accessibility features.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if an option is empty, considering zero as non-empty.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Returns a function that negates the result of the provided function.

methods.name: includes
methods.description: Checks if a string includes a query substring, case-insensitive, handling undefined, null, and boolean inputs.

methods.name: stripGroups
methods.description: Filters out group label options from options list.

methods.name: flattenOptions
methods.description: Flattens grouped options into a single list with group labels.

methods.name: flow
methods.description: Creates a function pipeline to process data through multiple functions.
